outcomes.title: How people’s sessions ended
outcomes.description: Completed: the last turn finished and something came of it within a day (a thumbs up, an approval carried out, a page the socio wrote, a memory kept). Abandoned: nobody came back within a day after a failure, a stop, an expired approval or a thumbs down. Answered: the rest.

chart.label: Chart
chart.empty: Nothing to chart in this range.

intents.title: Completion by intent
intents.description: How sessions ended by what people came for. Intents come from the session intent labels (Operations → Settings); sessions without one are counted apart. <link>Themes</link> breaks them down by topic.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: What socios asked to do, what people allowed, and what was carried out, by capability.
approvals.row: {{asked, number}} asked → {{allowed, number}} allowed, {{denied, number}} denied, {{expired, number}} expired → {{done, number}} done
approvals.row_failed: {{asked, number}} asked → {{allowed, number}} allowed, {{denied, number}} denied, {{expired, number}} expired → {{done, number}} done, {{failed, number}} failed

reactions.title: Reactions
reactions.description: How many socio answers got a reaction, and which. Few reactions say little either way.

lists.title: Usefulness and sessions
lists.description: Each socio’s completed share next to how often its people come back, and people’s sessions, newest first.
lists.socios-empty: No socio had people’s sessions in this range.

sessions.empty: No sessions like that in this range.
